meta.title: 懂点衣服小常识，避免穿衣小尴尬。

scenes.context: 买回来的衣服是不是经常遇到这种小尴尬？其实买的时候注意几个小细节，这些都能避免。
sentences: 买时注意细节就能避免。
scenes.speak: Clothes bring small awkward moments. Check details and avoid them.

scenes.context: 牛仔裤门襟越长坐下后越容易鼓包凸起，比男生还男生，一定要选门襟短的。
sentences: Long flies bunch when you sit.
paraphrase: Long flies bunch when you sit.
scenes.speak: Long flies bunch when you sit. Choose a short fly.

scenes.context: 拉链头和拉链大小有直接关系，把拉链头翻过来看数字，45就是3号拉链，相对细软不易导致硬条。
sentences: The zipper number is on the pull.
paraphrase: The zipper number is on the pull.
scenes.speak: The zipper number is on the pull. Size 3 zippers are softer.

scenes.context: 带里布的裙子要选里布和面料中间带小线泡的，能固定里布不乱跑，避免里布挂到腰上没下来。
sentences: Loops between layers hold the lining.
They stop the lining from riding up.
paraphrase: Loops between layers hold the lining.
They stop the lining from riding up.
scenes.speak: Loops between layers hold the lining. They stop the lining from riding up.

scenes.context: 想避免内衣透色尴尬，选接近皮肤颜色的肉色；浅色裙子一定要看是否挂好里布。
scenes.speak: Choose skin-toned underwear. Check light skirts for sheerness.

scenes.context: 无里布的浅色面料，透到戒指颜色都能清楚看见，那穿什么颜色的内裤都会被曝光。
sentences: Without lining, you see a ring's color.
paraphrase: Without lining, you see a ring's color.
scenes.speak: Without lining, you see a ring's color. Any underwear will show through.

scenes.context: 上衣带胸省的格外注意尖尖，要么做工问题要么省量太大，要选省量小、胸省是平缓弧线的。
sentences: 胸省尖是做工或省量大。
Sharp darts mean bad work or too much ease.
paraphrase: Sharp darts mean bad work or too much ease.
scenes.speak: Sharp darts mean bad work or too much ease. Choose smooth, gentle curves.

scenes.context: 正例的省道呈平缓弧线，而不是凸起的尖尖点，上身才没有尖尖的突兀感。
sentences: No sharp points on the body.
paraphrase: No sharp points on the body.
scenes.speak: Darts should curve gently. No sharp points on the body.

practice: Long flies bunch when you sit.
Loops between layers hold the lining.
